title: fix(console): the public form prints a form entry's own label, not the app bundle's object-field translation
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9BtJbyfcjefHVT9XXSMDFVR)_

Fixes #34375

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：公开表单页（console `FormPage`）里，表单项自己声明了 `label` 的行，直接显示表单接口返回的标签（已按访客语言本地化）；只有标签来自对象字段的行，才继续用应用翻译包的 `fields.对象.字段` 覆盖。必填提示和 `visibleWhen` 故障提示按同一规则点名字段。
- **为什么改**：浏览器里只要加载了应用翻译包（比如访客在同一 console 已登录），对象字段的坐席侧译名就会盖掉表单项的访客侧标签。HotCRM 公开支持表单因此显示「提交人姓名」而不是「您的姓名」，冷启动的匿名访问却显示正确，同一版本两种结果。
- **风险与回滚**：只改 console 一个组件的标签取值；行在构建时记下标签来源（`labelSource`），不比较字符串。没有表单项标签的行行为不变。无服务端、契约或 `@object-ui/i18n` 改动。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`ui/apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx` 的 `rowLabel`（组件内）与 `buildSections` 里新增的 `labelSource` 一行；其次 `FormPage.sectionLabelI18n.test.tsx` 末尾新增的一组测试。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run apps/console/src/components/FormPage.sectionLabelI18n.test.tsx`，预期 9 个测试全过（其中 3 个为本卡新增）。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **The row records where its label came from.** `RenderableField` gains `labelSource: 'entry' | 'object'`, set in `buildSections` from the same `??` that picks the label: `'entry'` when the form entry declared its own `label`, `'object'` when the row fell back to the object field's label (or its name). Nothing compares strings.
- **One naming rule for the row.** A component-local `rowLabel(object, f)` prints an `'entry'` label as served (the form endpoint already localized it from `_sections.SECTION.fields.FIELD.label`) and keeps `fieldLabel(object, f.name, f.label)`, the bundle overlay with the served label as fallback, for an `'object'` row. It replaces all four call sites: the row label on screen, the `visibleWhen`-fault banner, the required banner/toast and the per-row required message. So a refusal names a field by the label the visitor sees.
- **`fieldLabel` in `@object-ui/i18n` is unchanged.** Every other surface keeps bundle-first resolution for object fields.

## Why

The form endpoint serves the entry label correctly. The page then looked up `fields.OBJECT.FIELD` first, which translates the object field's agent-side label, and printed it whenever the browser held the app bundle. A signed-in visitor (or any visit with the bundle loaded) read the agent-side label; a cold anonymous visit (no bundle, see `FormPage.signedOutSectionI18n-12333.test.tsx`) read the entry label.

## Tests

New top-level `describe` in the existing public-form i18n harness `FormPage.sectionLabelI18n.test.tsx` (the file that already seeds an app bundle on the unwrapped `/f/:slug` route). The fixture's bundle translates both object fields (`supplied_name` → 提交人姓名, `supplied_email` → 提交人邮箱); the form entry for `supplied_name` declares `label: 您的姓名`, the entry for `supplied_email` declares none. Every leg asserts both strings.

- (a) `ENTRY_LABEL_RENDERS_AS_SERVED`: the row reads 您的姓名, 提交人姓名 is nowhere on the page, and the input is named by 您的姓名.
- (b) `REQUIRED_REFUSAL_NAMES_THE_VISIBLE_LABELS`: an empty submit's toast/banner message contains 您的姓名 and 提交人邮箱, not 提交人姓名; the per-row message the name input points at (`aria-describedby`) names 您的姓名.
- (c) CONTROL `OBJECT_LABEL_TAKES_THE_BUNDLE`: the row with no entry label reads 提交人邮箱, not the object's authored "Submitter email".

The `visibleWhen`-fault message goes through the same `rowLabel` call; it has no new pin of its own (the card asked for (a)–(c)).

**Forced test edits** (type only, no assertion changed): `RenderableField.labelSource` is required, so the hand-built row fixtures gain `labelSource: 'object'`: `FormPage.test.ts` (the `readPrefill` fields and the `remind_at` row), `FormPage.omitBlanksRebind.test.ts` (`row()`), `FormPage.optionDefault-13049.test.tsx` (the `priority` row). Without it `@object-ui/console` `type-check` reds (28 TS errors measured before the edit).

## Acceptance notes

- The internal in-app form route (`?form=ID`) renders through the same `buildSections` and the same `rowLabel`, so it follows the same rule. Whether that route's form view arrives with its entry labels already localized was not measured here; an entry label that is a plain string is printed as authored there, as it was whenever the bundle missed.
- An entry whose `label` happens to equal the object field's label is still an entry label and is printed as served (no string comparison, by the card's instruction).

## Verification

Readings taken on head `f29f7093` (base `6cc3f974`).

<details><summary>Ablations (each leg via scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, restored blob == HEAD, git diff HEAD empty)</summary>

- A1 `rowLabel` ignores provenance (`/* ablated */ fieldLabel(object, f.name, f.label)`): (a) and (b) red, (c) green. `expected '提交人姓名' to be '您的姓名'`; `expected '必填项：提交人姓名、提交人邮箱' to contain '您的姓名'`. 2 failed, 7 passed.
- A2 `buildSections` always `labelSource: 'object'`: the same two legs red with the same messages. 2 failed, 7 passed.
- A3 no overlay at all (`/* ablated */ f.label`): (c) red (`expected 'Submitter email' to be '提交人邮箱'`), (b) red on its 提交人邮箱 half, and the existing `FIELD_LABEL_IS_TRANSLATED` red. 3 failed, 6 passed.

The console test imports `FormPage` from source, so no dist rebuild sits between mutation and run.
</details>

<details><summary>Local runs</summary>

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run apps/console/src/components/FormPage.sectionLabelI18n.test.tsx`: 9/9.
- Every console test file that names `FormPage` or `buildSections` (62 files): `Test Files 62 passed (62)`, `Tests 557 passed (557)`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console run type-check`: exit 0.
- `pnpm exec eslint` on the five touched files: 0 errors; warning counts equal to base for `FormPage.tsx` (26) and `FormPage.test.ts` (2).
- `pnpm --dir ui check:new-line-citations`: 0 new citations.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 37 commands, each run on the final head, all exit 0 (list in the os-dev-report on the card).
</details>
